description: Test suite for detecting inline evaluation commands and patterns in command-line arguments, mainly focusing on identifying interpreters, inline programs, and command carriers.

methods.name: detectInterpreterInlineEvalArgv
methods.description: Detects whether command-line arguments invoke an interpreter with inline evaluation or command.

methods.name: describeInterpreterInlineEval
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the inline eval pattern.

methods.name: isInterpreterLikeAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Checks if a command pattern matches known interpreter-like allowlist patterns.
